I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace. The caller supplied resolved PR values for home, so `reference/pr-head.md` replaces Steps 0 and 1.

## Legend

**Aliases:** ROOT=`/work/widget`, W=`/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` (NAME=`fix-retry`), A=`aaaa…a` (40), B=`bbbb…b`, C=`cccc…c`, D=`dddd…d`. SYNC=merge (N=1, no members).

**Discovery (every row, cwd = session dir, never changed):**

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` | common=`/work/widget/.git` → ROOT |
| D2 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | empty, so not a submodule |
| D3 | Overrides ladder; native tool; wrapper | none, so home=W |
| D4 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | ok |
| D5 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}`; `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | exists; =A |
| D6 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | BASE_SHA=B |
| D7 | Stops in order: isCrossRepository; `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain`; reachability; `git -C ROOT show-ref --verify refs/heads/fix/retry` | none hit; no local branch; no rework-base ref |

**Success path (S):**

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` | clean |
| S2 | `git -C ROOT check-ignore -q .worktrees` | ignored, so no commit |
| S3 | `git -C ROOT symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` | empty, so provenance note skipped |
| S4 | `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` | Git's DWIM resolves this to `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`; the caller passes no `-b` |
| S5 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain`; `git -C W rev-parse HEAD`; `git -C W branch --show-current` | `worktree W`; =A; branch check is advisory (singleton) |
| S6 | Capture | PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A, BASE_SHA=B |
| S7 | `git -C W update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-82 A` | ok |
| S8 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | already up to date, so no commit |
| S9 | `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` | exit 0 |

Base-SHA constraint reads are owned by `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`.

**Report R:**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa (clean)
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: aaaa…a
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
Ready to implement rework of acme/widget#82
```

**Stop boundary (SB):** stops happen after D4 (the fetch touches remote-tracking refs only). At that point no file has been created or modified, no `worktree add` has run, no ref has been written, and nothing has been pushed.

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from legend |
|---|---|
| linked | D1 gives git-dir `/work/widget/.git/worktrees/other` and common `/work/widget/.git`, so ROOT=`/work/widget`. The session tree `other` is not the selected home on fix/retry, so it is not adopted and nothing is nested inside it. Every command uses `-C ROOT`/`-C W`. Run S; report R. |
| primary | Run D and S unchanged; report R. |
| ancestor | D7 finds local fix/retry=C. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. Then `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry` (never `branch -f`). S4 becomes `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` on the existing branch, with no DWIM. Then S5–S9; report R. |
| reuse | D7 lists `worktree W` on fix/retry, which is the selected home, not "elsewhere". Rebase check: `git -C W rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and `… rebase-apply` return no directory. The ancestry check exits 0. `git -C W status --porcelain` is clean. `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry` moves C to A. No S2–S4, no provenance note (not a fresh creation). Then S5–S9; report R. |
| fork | Stop: `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` SB applies. |
| elsewhere | Stop: `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` SB applies. |
| unreachable | D5 verify fails. Stop: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` SB applies. |
| moved | D5 shows origin/fix/retry=D≠A. Same stop text as unreachable. SB applies. |
| ahead | Local branch=C, no rework-base ref, so the N=1 ancestry check runs and exits 1. Stop: `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` SB applies; the local commits are preserved. |
| diverged | Same as ahead: same stop text, SB applies. |
| override | `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` has `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`; no `home:` key, so home=W. The create contains `-b`, so it is skipped and built-in S4 (DWIM) runs. The keyed post-create check passes. Report R plus `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. |
| race | S4 succeeds, but S5 HEAD=D≠A. Stop: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry: HEAD dddd…d does not equal PR #82 head aaaa…a (post-create race); tree left intact.` The tree is the only write. No S6–S9 and no ready line. |

**Ordinary-home control:** This singleton run has no coordinated marked-home N>1 context, so "Recover coordinated base sync" does not apply. The local fix/retry is a clean two-parent base-sync merge, and ancestry exits 1. Stop: `local branch fix/retry is at <local tip sha7>, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` SB applies; the merge commit is preserved.

## History

- **Pre-rework ref:** `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-82`=A is recorded on every successful row and preserved afterward.
- **No rework-base ref:** merge mode never writes `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-82`.
- **Merge-forward:** the history never rewrites A, and S9's ancestry of A must hold.
- **Allowed later rewrites:**
  - the appended-spec approval `commit --amend --no-edit`;
  - the appended-wave fold `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`, provided WAVE_BASE_SHA descends from PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A.
